difficulty_reason: Verify the functor p_ft : Spacesstack_ft -> (Sch/S)_fppf satisfies conditions (1), (2), (3) of stacks-definition-stack: (1) fibred category - by lemma-spaces-strongly-cartesian a strongly cartesian morphism (f, g) has f : X -> U x_V Y an isomorphism, and base change preserves finite type (spaces-morphisms-lemma-base-change-finite-type), so strongly cartesian morphisms of Spacesstack between finite-type objects stay in Spacesstack_ft, making it a fibred category, and the inclusion is a 1-morphism of fibred categories; (2) the Mor presheaves in Spacesstack_ft are sheaves because the full-subcategory identification Mor_{Spacesstack_ft}(X, Y) = Mor_{Spacesstack}(X, Y) (stacks-lemma-presheaf-mor-map-fibred-categories) transfers the sheaf property from lemma-pre-stack-of-spaces; (3) descent - given fppf covering {U_i -> U} with finite-type spaces X_i and cocycle isomorphisms, Bootstrap lemma-descend-algebraic-space part (2) produces the descended algebraic space X and spaces-descent-lemma-descending-property-locally-finite-presentation keeps X -> U of finite type.
